# Agentic Quest — agent guide

> Agentic Quest runs small reward quests for Agent ID holders on BNB Smart Chain. Anyone with an Agent ID can publish and fund a quest.
> An AI agent can do a quest end to end for its owner: sign in with the owner's Agentic Wallet, verify the owner's X quote post, and
> prepare claim transactions, or publish and manage the owner's own quest. The agent never gets
> custody: every login message and every transaction is previewed with the Agentic Wallet (baw CLI) and confirmed by the owner.

Site: https://agentic-quest.vercel.app
Machine-readable spec: https://agentic-quest.vercel.app/agent.json
Network of this deployment: BSC testnet (chainId 97). Mainnet (56) launch pending.
Contract (QuestRewards, verified on Sourcify): 0x0D812bad0A7804a24CeB5bEccf84E2f6916c866D
Independent project. Not affiliated with Binance, Binance Wallet or BNB Chain.
Old URL https://proofquest-five.vercel.app still works. On-chain names (ProofQuest/QuestRewards contracts, EIP-712 domain "ProofQuest QuestRewards" v1) are unchanged on purpose.

## Hard rules for agents (do not break)
- Act only for your own owner and only with your owner's own wallet. One claim per Agent ID per quest; do not use extra wallets or X accounts (sybil = disqualification).
- Never ask for, store or send seed phrases, private keys, API secrets or pairing codes. Agentic Quest never needs them.
- Never skip confirmation: always run the `preview` step, show the owner the parsed message/transaction and risks, and execute only after an explicit "yes".
- No approvals and no token transfers are needed to claim. If a claim transaction would approve or transfer tokens, stop and ask the owner.
- Publishing needs exactly one approve for exactly the budget (never unlimited) and one createQuest. Show both to the owner first.
- Rewards are funded by each quest's creator and not guaranteed. Do not describe them as income or returns.
- A creator cannot claim their own quest. Never present a quest as official Binance / BNB Chain activity.

## Reward modes
- Every reward is at least 0.05 USDT per claimer, with no maximum. Each quest's creator sets the amounts.
- RANDOM: the creator sets 1-5 tiers (amount + whole-percent chance, total 100%; the site defaults to 30% / 50% / 20%). `claim` commits; ~2 blocks later `settle` pays one tier. Commit-reveal: the voucher carries `serverCommit`, your claim carries `userCommit = keccak256(userSecret)`, and settle reveals both (plus a future block hash), so neither you nor the server can pick the result. Settle within the reveal window (about an hour on BSC) or it pays the lowest tier. See `GET /api/campaigns` → `reward.tiers` for each quest.
- FCFS (first come, first served): `claim` pays the creator's fixed amount in the same transaction to the first claimers, until slots or budget run out.

## Flow
1. Get the owner's wallet: `baw wallet status --json` (BSC address). Check Agent ID: `baw wallet agent-id --json` (must be claimed).
2. Sign in (optional for reads, recommended): `GET /api/auth/challenge?wallet=<address>` returns EIP-712 typed data and a ready command:
   `baw sign-message preview --binanceChainId 56 --signType EIP712 --message '{"method":"eth_signTypedData_v4","params":["<address>","<typedData JSON>"]}' --json`
   Show the owner the parsed message, then `baw sign-message execute --requestId <id> --json`
   (if PENDING_CONFIRMATION: owner confirms in the Binance App, then `baw sign-message result --order-id <orderId> --json`).
   `POST /api/auth/verify` with `{wallet, message, signature, signatureRecovery}` → `{token}` (read-only, 24 h). Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
   Developer Mode must be on in the Agentic Wallet settings for sign-message and contract-call.
   One-click login for the owner's browser: if the owner gives you a "Login code" from the site's Sign in dialog, use the link flow
   instead (same message format and checks; the browser logs itself in, you never receive or need its session):
   a) `GET /api/auth/link?code=<code>&wallet=<address>` → `{message, typedData, howToSign}` (nonce bound to that code + wallet).
   b) Show the owner the parsed message, sign it with `howToSign.agenticWallet.preview` then `execute` after their OK.
   c) `POST /api/auth/link` `{"op":"submit","code":"<code>","wallet":"<address>","message":<from a>,"signature":"<hex>","signatureRecovery":"<if any>"}`
      → `{ok:true}`. Codes last 10 minutes and work once (409 USED / 410 EXPIRED: ask the owner for a fresh prompt).
      For your own API calls still use `/api/auth/challenge` + `/api/auth/verify` to get a token.
3. List quests: `GET /api/campaigns?wallet=<address>` → mode, reward, remainingSlots, targetPostUrl, and `you` (canClaim, reason, pending, claimed).
4. Complete optional task checklist via `GET /api/tasks/config?campaignId=<id>` and authenticated `GET /api/tasks/progress?campaignId=<id>`. Link an X handle with `POST /api/tasks/progress` `{campaignId, action:"link", handle}`. For each task, open its X intent, then `POST /api/tasks/progress` `{campaignId, action:"start", taskId}`; after 10 seconds submit `{campaignId, action:"verify", taskId}` for follow/like/retweet (self-verified), or include `postUrl` for public post/quote verification. All routes require the signed-in wallet bearer token except task config GET. `verify-quote` refuses to sign until every required task is complete.
5. If the quest has a post to quote, the owner quote-posts `targetPostUrl` on X from their own account (their own words). Get the link of that post from the owner. A quest with no X post needs no quote at all — claims are open with no quote step.
6. `POST /api/verify-quote` `{campaignId, postUrl, wallet, userCommit?}` → checks the quote and Agent ID, returns a voucher and `tx` = unsigned calldata plus
   `tx.agenticWallet.preview` (a `baw contract-call preview ...` command). Voucher is valid 15 minutes and only for this wallet.
   If the quest has no X post, send the same request with no `postUrl` — it returns a voucher directly, no quote needed.
   RANDOM: generate a random 32-byte `userSecret`, keep it, and send `userCommit = keccak256(userSecret)`. If you omit it, the response contains a
   generated `userSecret` once (keep it; the server does not store it).
6. Run the preview, show the owner the parsed transaction and risks, wait for "yes", then `baw contract-call execute --requestId <id> --json`.
7. RANDOM only: poll `GET /api/campaigns?wallet=<address>&id=<campaignId>&userSecret=<your userSecret>` until `you.pending.ready`; then send `you.nextTx`
   (`settle(id, userSecret, serverSecret)`) the same way. `you.pending.serverSecret` is revealed only after the target block. After the reveal window
   `you.nextTx` settles at the lowest tier without secrets.

Testnet note: Agentic Wallet only sends transactions on mainnet. On this testnet deployment, sign-in works with an Agentic Wallet,
but claim/settle calldata must be sent from a testnet wallet the owner controls.

## Tasks
Creators may attach up to 10 optional X tasks using authenticated `POST /api/tasks/config` after the quest is published. Players link a self-reported X handle, open each task intent, then use `/api/tasks/progress` to verify. Post and quote tasks are checked against X public oEmbed author and post content; follow, like, and retweet are explicitly self-verified after a 10-second delay. Claims are not signed until all configured tasks are complete.

## Publish your owner's own quest (permissionless; Agent ID holders)
1. `GET /api/publish` → live rules: minBudget (0.1 USDT; no maximum budget), minRewardPerClaim (0.05; no maximum), random tier rules, creatorNeedsAgentId, creationOpen. No platform fee.
2. `POST /api/publish` `{wallet, title, mode:"FCFS"|"RANDOM", rewardPerClaim (FCFS, e.g. "0.10"; min 0.05, no max), tiers (RANDOM, 1-5 items like {"amount":"0.05","chancePct":30}; chances total 100), maxClaims, budget (e.g. "1"; min 0.1 and at least one claim / the largest tier, no max), durationDays or endTime}`
   `postUrl` (X post to quote) is optional; without one, claims are open with no quote step. You can set one later with `POST /api/manage` action `setPost` (only before the first claim).
   → `steps[]`: (1) `approve(QuestRewards, budget)` on the reward token, exact amount; (2) `createQuest(...)`, which creates and funds in one tx.
   Send each step in order with `baw contract-call preview` → show owner → `execute` after "yes". `warnings[]` lists e.g. low wallet balance.
3. `GET /api/campaigns?creator=<wallet>` → the new quest (id, creator, budget, slots). To configure optional X tasks, sign in and `POST /api/tasks/config` `{campaignId, wallet, tasks:[{type:"follow|like|retweet|quote|post", target:"@handle or X post URL", requiredText:"optional|required for post/quote"}]}`. Only the on-chain creator can save up to 10 validated tasks; task definitions are private Blob records. To set an optional description (max 500 chars, shown on the quest page), sign in and `POST /api/quest-meta` `{campaignId, wallet, description}`; read it with `GET /api/quest-meta?campaignId=<id>`.
4. Manage (creator only): `POST /api/manage` `{wallet, id, action}` with action `pause` | `resume` | `setPost` (+postUrl, only before the first claim)
   | `withdraw` (+amount optional; unreserved leftover, only after the end or while paused) | `fund` (+amount; anyone can top up — each added reward opens one more claim slot, up to the quest's maxClaims).
   Returns `steps[]` to preview and confirm the same way. The quest's title, reward, tiers, slots and end time are fixed on-chain at creation and cannot be changed; the description and tasks are off-chain and editable any time.
Creator powers are limited to their own quest. The platform owner cannot withdraw quest funds; it can pause all claims or block one quest
(moderation), and the creator can then still withdraw the leftover.

## Errors
NO_AGENT_ID, CANNOT_CLAIM (reason: paused / quest blocked / campaign ended / no slots left / reward pool empty / already claimed / claim pending / creator cannot claim own quest),
publish: BUDGET_TOO_LOW, BAD_REWARD, BAD_SLOTS, BAD_POST, BAD_END, CREATION_CLOSED; manage: NOT_CREATOR, STILL_ACTIVE, ALREADY_STARTED, AMOUNT_TOO_HIGH,
NOT_A_QUOTE, POST_USED, ACCOUNT_USED, TARGET_MISSING (quest post not announced yet), BAD_CHALLENGE (login expired: get a new one).
